name: Solar panels, inverters and batteries (assembly and distribution)

problems.words: Panel rates drop after we buy and we lose on stock in the godown
quick_ideas: Note stock on hand and the rate you bought at — shows your real exposure
Buy closer to confirmed orders — less stock exposed to rate drops.

workzap_build.text: a daily rate board for buying and selling rates with stock value updated.

problems.ask_first: How much stock do you usually hold?
problems.free_stops: The buying rules and exposure view are in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many godown units were bought above today's supplier rate, so you see which stock is hurting margin now.
Give one person a weekly bought-rate notebook by batch, so future rate drops are spotted before repeat buying.

problems.words: We don't record serial numbers so warranty claims become arguments
quick_ideas: Record serials of every panel, inverter and battery at installation — links equipment to the project
Photograph serial labels — proof for claims.

workzap_build.text: a serial register captured at goods-in and linked to the customer project on installation.

problems.ask_first: Who records serials now, if anyone?
problems.free_stops: The capture steps are in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Check one recent delivery file against goods already sent out, so missing serial records show up before the next warranty dispute.
Give dispatch one notebook kept beside packed goods, so every outgoing serial is tied to the customer without arguments later.

problems.words: Install teams say a job is done but the customer says it isn't working
quick_ideas: Ask for photos at handover — shows the job as left
Get customer confirmation at handover — settles disputes.

workzap_build.text: an installation job checklist on the phone with photos at each step, sign-off and customer confirmation.

problems.ask_first: How many installation teams do you run?
problems.free_stops: The checklist content is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare jobs marked done this week against customer callbacks received, so you see which teams leave unclear handovers.
Make one supervisor collect an end-of-job call note before crews leave, so incomplete jobs are caught the same day.

problems.words: Too many WhatsApp leads and we can't follow up all
quick_ideas: List every open enquiry with its status — shows who's waiting
Give one person ownership of follow-ups — nothing dropped.

workzap_build.text: a lead inbox for WhatsApp and Facebook enquiries with status, reminders and source tracking.

problems.ask_first: How many enquiries come in a week?
problems.free_stops: The follow-up flow is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count open WhatsApp enquiries from this week that still lack a reply, so you see today's missed sales workload clearly.
Give one staff member a single follow-up list reviewed at one fixed time daily, so waiting enquiries stop getting missed.

problems.words: Quote takes too long because we calculate each system manually
quick_ideas: Keep a current component price sheet — speeds every quote
Keep your past quotes for the common setups in one folder, so a new quote starts from a similar one.

workzap_build.text: a quote builder covering components, structure, cable, labour and margin with branded output.

problems.free_stops: The quote logic is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Note how long recent quotes sat before going out, so you see where manual calculation is slowing sales replies.
Keep one notebook of common package prices updated by one person, so repeat quotes go out faster with fewer recalculations.

problems.words: Customers pay the last instalment only after net metering is approved
quick_ideas: List every pending final payment with its file stage — shows what's holding cash
Note days waiting for each file — gives facts to chase.

workzap_build.text: an instalment tracker linked to milestones and a net-metering file tracker showing days at each stage.

problems.free_stops: The milestone and file-tracking set-up is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count pending last instalments by approval paper sitting with customer, office or utility, so you see where cash gets stuck most.
Give one staff member one daily handover list for approval-linked final payments, so customer follow-up stays tied to each file stage.

problems.words: Project costs go over and we eat it
quick_ideas: Compare planned versus actual materials on recent projects — shows where it goes over
Note extras approved at site — they should be charged.

workzap_build.text: project costing with planned versus actual materials and labour per project.

problems.free_stops: The costing method is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare what was planned and actually used on one finished job, so the main source of overruns becomes visible.
Give one site lead one extras page per job, so every added cost is noted while work is still fresh.

problems.words: Team schedule is on WhatsApp and jobs clash
quick_ideas: Put the coming week's jobs on one board by team — shows clashes
Confirm the next day with each team in the evening — fewer surprises.

workzap_build.text: a team scheduler showing which team is at which site each day.

problems.free_stops: The scheduling set-up is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Write all jobs for the coming week by team on one page, so clashes and double-booking show before crews leave.
Give one dispatcher the evening handover for next-day team assignments, so mixed messages stop between office and field crews.

problems.words: Customers get no maintenance reminders and then complain
quick_ideas: List past installations with their dates — shows who is due
Contact a few, with their permission — shows customers you care.

workzap_build.text: maintenance reminders on WhatsApp for customers who opt in.

problems.ask_first: Do you have customers' permission to message them?
problems.free_stops: Reminder timing is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count past installations with no maintenance contact noted this month, so you see how many customers may complain silently.
Give one person a single notebook of installed jobs by month, so reminder calls happen in a steady routine.

never_say: No system sizing, electrical design, wiring, earthing or battery-safety advice.
Never estimate savings, payback or bill reductions.
No advice on net-metering rules, DISCO/DEWA/utility policies or incentive eligibility.
Fires, smoke, swelling batteries, shocks or roof falls: stop and point to emergency services.
Never help sell grey-market or refurbished equipment as new, swap serials, fake warranty cards or under-invoice imports; decline.
No bill reference numbers, CNIC/Emirates ID or addresses stored.

sample_reply.person: Koi hal hai? Warranty claim pe har dafa behes hoti hai kyun ke serial number kahin likha hi nahi hota.
sample_reply.pi: Ji, is ka hal seedha hai. 1) Har installation par panels, inverter aur battery ke serial note karein, taake har cheez project se jude. 2) Serial labels ki photo le lein, taake claim par saboot ho. Workzap yeh aap ke liye khud-ba-khud kar sakta hai: serial register jo goods-in par serial le aur installation par customer project se jod de, phir claim aate hi record saamne ho. Kya main aap ke liye solution document aur quote banwa doon? Mana bhi kar sakte hain.
